author: GamingBolt
description:
As much as it doesn't feel real, and as agonising as the wait has been, it's finally time: Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19th at midnight local time on Xbox Series X/S and PS5. It almost doesn't feel real to say that, but alas, here we are: After years of delays, not to mention the decade-plus since Grand Theft Auto 5 launched, we're finally delving back into Rockstar's insanely detailed universe.

Jason and Lucia are the protagonists this time around – a couple of short-time crooks who look to score big and end up embroiled in a criminal conspiracy. Even more significant is how their adventures unfold across Leonida, a fictitious version of Florida, and include Vice City's return. We haven't visited it since 2002's GTA: Vice City, but since it's set in the modern day, a lot has changed.

There's still so much to unravel about Grand Theft Auto 6, from the sheer amount of detail in everything to how the storyline plays out; the choices players can make and how they'll affect
title: GTA 6 - 15 FINAL NEW Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
